# GM Tools Hub
> Free browser-based tools, calculators, converters, templates and learning pages by Gmd Khan Niazi (Ghulam Mohiuddin Khan Niazi), Lahore, Pakistan. Tools run in the browser and do not upload what you type.

## Main sections
- [Free tools and gadgets](https://gmtoolshub.com/tools/): 74 tools, including PDF and image converters, calculators, Pakistan salary tax, zakat, tola, marla, electricity bill, fuel cost and amount in words
- [Unit conversions](https://gmtoolshub.com/convert/): marla, kanal, tola, maund, seer and common unit conversions
- [Pakistan salary tax tables](https://gmtoolshub.com/salary-tax/): monthly tax by salary for 2026-27
- [Blog and guides](https://gmtoolshub.com/blog/): money, careers, Excel and sales operations
- [Free Excel templates](https://gmtoolshub.com/free-templates/): attendance, KPI scorecard and monthly budget planner
- [Free live rates widget](https://gmtoolshub.com/embed-rates/): embeddable Pakistan gold, silver and USD to PKR estimates, updated daily, English or Urdu
- [Send money to Pakistan calculator](https://gmtoolshub.com/send-money-to-pakistan/): compare fees and exchange-rate margin for USD, GBP, EUR, AED, SAR, CAD, AUD and QAR
- [Daily rates email](https://gmtoolshub.com/daily-rates-email/): free short daily email with estimated gold, silver and dollar rates
- [Rates data (JSON)](https://gmtoolshub.com/rates-data/): free daily JSON for gold, silver and PKR exchange rates with field notes and terms
- [Get expert help](https://gmtoolshub.com/get-expert-help/): request an introduction to an independent tax, accounting or web professional
- [GM Embed](https://gmtoolshub.com/gm-embed/): embed tested GM Tools Hub calculators on your own website; generator, documentation and planned plans
- [About the author](https://gmtoolshub.com/about/)

## Notes
- Calculators give estimates for general information. Rates, tax slabs and prices are entered or checked by the user.
- Full page map: https://gmtoolshub.com/llms-full.txt
